# A package that loads with errors may miss a template that links any
# stylesheet, so its author CSS is unknown: the partial is left as
# written, and the load error is reported.

! muxt fmt -w partial.gohtml
cmp partial.gohtml partial.orig
cmpenv stderr want-err.txt

-- go.mod --
module example.com

go 1.24
-- templates.go --
package server

import "embed"

//go:embed *.gohtml *.css
var templatesFS embed.FS
-- partial.gohtml --
<section>
<div class="code">
  keep   me
</div>
</section>

<section>
<div class="code">
  keep   me
</div>
</section>
